name: warehouse_zoned_100
description: Zoned warehouse for the 100-AMR scale scenario. 24x12 grid of aisle intersections (138 m x 66 m), partitioned into 24 zones as 6 column bands x 4 row bands. Every aisle is a single lane driven either way, as on the 30-AMR floor, with consignments collected in the aisle at 121 pickups along the pick-aisles. Requires 16-bit ids (its edges exceed the 8-bit ceiling of 255). Zone count is set by the NFR-1.12 frame budget under FR-9.3 adjacent-zone eligibility -- see ZONE_BUDGET_NOTE in scripts/generate_maps.py.
